title: Set Your Fire
blurb: Find your ground, light the Ember on it, and give it a name.

steps.hint: Ilse or Hettie gives you one when you have none.

steps.text: Find open, level ground away from gates and the city.
steps.hint: The Ember refuses soft or open air, the city, anywhere within 64 blocks of a gate, and another Hearth's ground.

steps.text: Set the Ember down on the top of a block.

steps.hint: A card offers a name from the land's own words. Enter keeps it.
